public_rationale: Studies available before the post repeatedly found performance drops on controlled variants of familiar tasks. That supports the ordinary reading of a recurring weakness. The arithmetic study supplies an important limit: some frontier models generalized well to new examples. The evidence supports a tendency, not universal failure or proof that answers were retrieved from memorized training items.
limitations: The evidence covers selected models and tasks.
Counterfactual task settings are proxies for unfamiliarity, not direct inspections of training data.
Good generalization in some settings is material counterevidence to a stronger blanket reading.
The claim does not establish that LLMs cannot reason.
